Start date: 1880-01-17  
Add 15 weeks = 105 days.  
Add 1 more day = 106 days total.  
1880 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100).  
January has 31 days, February has 29 days in 1880.  

From 1880-01-17:  
Days left in January = 31 - 17 = 14 days → 1880-01-31.  
February: 29 days → after 14+29 = 43 days → 1880-03-01.  
Remaining days to add = 106 - 43 = 63 days.  

March: 31 days → 1880-04-01 after 31 days from Mar 1 (32 days used).  
Remaining = 63 - 31 = 32 days.  
April: 30 days → 1880-05-01 after 30 days (62 days used).  
Remaining = 32 - 30 = 2 days.  

Add 2 days to 1880-05-01 → 1880-05-03.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1880-05-03
